author: Yffe
content: Minimal single-file fix: correct render_type_arm's Type::Unit arm example in thermite-skill/src/generate.rs from `fn log() -> () ens true fx pure { }` to `fn log() -> () req true ens true fx pure { }` (add the mandatory req clause; clauses now in req->ens->fx order per thermite-design.md §4.1). Root cause is the invalid example STRING, not the REQ-8 compile-force mechanism (untouched). Re-checked every other render_*_arm example: all other fn/spec-fn examples are intentional ..-placeholder fragments or bare signatures (not standalone programs); only the Type::Unit arm was a complete program and the only invalid one. Un-ignore the pinned test rendered_fn_examples_parse_clean and broaden it to sweep EVERY complete rendered fn/spec-fn example and assert each parses clean (permanent regression guard). Regenerate THERMITE.skill.md. Authority: thermite-design.md §10/§4.1, skill-generator.md REQ-8/REQ-10.
